name: 训练恢复即饮浓醇蛋白奶昔款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用整托加单瓶的组合同时交代形态与量贩感。
主图一秒法则：纯色场加大字带把使用立场一眼传达给训练人群。
shots.textZone: 中央空白标题带一句立场卖点位

shots.intent: 用摇匀后冰镇腾沫的动态一帧证明浓稠即饮口感，把开盖动作变成食欲点。
shots.textZone: 左上留白带一条短标签位

shots.intent: 让目标买家把自己代入训练结束那一刻，建立使用时刻与频次联想。
用风味原料与挂壁质地的微距证据回应口味是否浓稠的疑虑。
把规格与数量信息放进左右撞色分屏的空白格，让人一眼读到买的是什么组合。
shots.textZone: 右侧空白数值块与下方两条短标签位

shots.intent: 用居中短标题加整齐留空正文行的版面承诺信息透明，降低配方疑虑。
shots.textZone: 奶白面板上方一条空标题带与六行空正文行位

shots.intent: 以留空参数表的版面结构回答营养成分怎么看，把表格位置先占好交给后期填真值。
shots.textZone: 奶白卡片标题带与八行空表格单元位

shots.intent: 收口把整箱与随身单瓶放在一起，暗示囤货加随身的购买理由。
shots.textZone: 右下空按钮框一条短标签位

style.backgroundSystem: flat single colour planes: cobalt #2E6FD0 for statement, spec and close screens, cocoa #6B4630 for flavour and product panels, seamless pure white #FFFFFF only on the packshot; no scenery, no gradient mesh
style.direction: bold flat colour-block sports nutrition commerce
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin rules, empty pill button blocks and blank seal frames in accent #B6CC2E, no pictograms and no badges
style.lightingSystem: even high-key graphic light with a front-left key and soft fill, one soft contact shadow per object, no falloff or vignette; skimming side light only on the texture macro
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bold flat colour-block sports nutrition visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cobalt #2E6FD0, cocoa brown #6B4630, warm off-white #F2EDE4 and one lime accent #B6CC2E; cool even high-key graphic lighting with a front-left key, soft fill and one soft contact shadow per object; flat single colour planes as the only background system, one warm off-white paper panel for information screens; one modern geometric sans-serif family with oversized statement bands and short label bars, all wording left as blank blocks for post compositing; thin single-weight rules, empty pill button blocks and blank seal frames only; stable slight 3/4 or flat side-profile product angle and identical product scale; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no gradient mesh or glow, no filled numbers or badges inside blank blocks.
noDrift: no mixed fonts or serif lettering
no gradient mesh, glow or 3D stage effects
no filled-in numbers, units or badges inside blank blocks
style.presentationRules: bottle held at a stable slight 3/4 or a flat 90-degree side profile with identical scale and label placement across screens, never covered by props, always grounded by its own contact shadow
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless colour planes plus one warm off-white paper panel #F2EDE4; no wood, no marble, no fabric tabletop
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family, oversized statement band plus short label bars, all real wording composited in post so the render only carries blank type blocks
